claims.title: Author counts are rebuilt on each call and cannot accumulate across readers or days
claims.conclusion: This function rebuilds its author-count table for every call; its inputs are author IDs and ranking scores, with no count of today's posts, midnight reset, or four-hour recovery timer. For another reader whose pool contains only A2, A2 can become that author's first post.
conditions: This statement concerns only this author-diversity function
Another reader's candidate pool may differ
